create.name: The Shala – Cape Town Yoga School
create.bio:
The Shala is a yoga school in the Gardens neighbourhood of Cape Town, set in a restored heritage building on Dunkley Square with a high-ceilinged practice room and old wooden floors. Tamsin Sheehy opened it in 2007. Her own grounding runs through several lineages: Ashtanga, Vinyasa and Iyengar practice, a first training with Louisa Sears, two years of Bihar-school training in Pretoria, and study of Sivananda asana, chanting, puja and philosophy in Kerala, followed by advanced training in Hong Kong.

The school's main work is teacher education. Its 200-hour training, registered with Yoga Alliance, runs part-time over weekends and covers alignment, sequencing, pranayama, yoga philosophy and history, self-inquiry and anatomy; a 300-hour programme in three ten-day modules and a mentorship scheme for working teachers follow on from it. A faculty of senior teachers, several of them Shala graduates, also teach a full timetable of public classes that pair traditional philosophy with careful alignment, alongside visiting workshops and an on-demand online library through the school's app. The Shala supports the Earthchild Project, which brings yoga to schoolchildren.

courses.title: 200-Hour Teacher Training 2027
courses.description: A part-time Yoga Alliance 200-hour course held over weekends at the Gardens studio from February to June 2027. It covers asana alignment and sequencing, props, pranayama, yogic philosophy and self-inquiry, yoga history and lineage, anatomy and supervised teaching. Bursaries are offered; the early-bird price is R20,000.

courses.title: In-studio classes and memberships
courses.description: Public classes at the Dunkley Square studio taught by the school's senior teachers, combining traditional yoga philosophy with precise alignment. Options run from a single class to class passes and unlimited monthly or yearly memberships.

courses.title: The Shala Online
courses.description: An on-demand library of classes filmed by The Shala's RYT500 teachers, with new sessions added each week and available through the school's app. Weekly, monthly and yearly plans are offered, and first-time subscribers can try it for a month.
